rawContent: Probably not what I should be watching to relax and restore, but @Station19 and @GreysABC are truly some of the best shows. Their pertinence and validation of our experiences is invaluable. Thank you @shondarhimes and all on these teams! #BlackLivesMatter #racialjustice

Guilty. Guilty. Guilty! 

While we knew #Chauvin was #GUILTY, our corrupt racist justice system still caused us to worry whether this would be the verdict. 

Now to await sentencing. 

It ain’t ova yet. #GeorgeFloydTrial #GeorgeFloydverdict #BlackLivesMatter

Don’t confuse relief with justice or a long awaited sigh for breathing freely. This is not a victory. This is accountability. #GeorgeFloydTrial #GeorgeFloydverdict #georgefloyd #ChauvinTrial #BlackLivesMatter

@SpeakerPelosi Pls tell me you didn’t actually thank #GeorgeFloyd for “sacrificing” his life for justice. He was MURDERED. Congress needs to enroll in DEI professional development because clearly your implicit biases are endangering our existence. #BlackLivesMatter #MakiyahBryant

I tweeted earlier abt a sigh of relief then met with news abt #makhiabryant. However, I misspelled her name. It is disheartening 2 learn nat’l media misspelled her name resulting in an incorrect trend & hashtag. This is additional violence 2 her & her family. I am so sorry. #BLM
Less than 10 minutes into @Station19 ... sigh. So grateful for the writers of this show. #BlackLivesMatter #Station19
